title: Anlatı
canDo: Bir hikâyeyi bütün anlatı zamanlarını (past perfect continuous dahil) ustaca kullanarak, güçlü sıfat ve zarflarla, dinleyicinin ilgisini canlı tutacak şekilde anlatabilirim.
grammar: anlatı zamanları: tekrar ve ince farklar
past perfect simple ve continuous farkı
zaman bağlaçları: as soon as, the moment, no sooner... than (giriş)

liveClass.title: Hikâye gecesi
liveClass.goal: Her öğrenci başından geçmiş (ya da hayali) unutulmaz bir olayı 2 dakikada anlatır. Anlatımda en az bir past perfect continuous cümlesi, iki güçlü sıfat ve bir gerilim anı olmalıdır. Dinleyenler You'll never guess... / What happened next? gibi tepkilerle katılır, sonunda sınıf en sürükleyici hikâyeyi seçer ve öğretmen dil kullanımına geri bildirim verir.

lessons.title: Zamanlar sahnede
lessons.goal: Past simple, past continuous ve past perfect'i bir hikâyede bilinçli olarak ve doğru sırayla kullanabilirim.

discover.title: Sisli gece
discover.body:
It was nearly midnight when Elif finally left the office. A thick fog had come in from the sea, and the streets were completely empty.

She was walking towards the car park when she heard footsteps behind her. She stopped. The footsteps stopped too.

Her heart was pounding. She had read about a series of robberies in the area, and she had promised her mother that she would never walk alone at night.

She turned around slowly. A tall figure was standing under the streetlight, holding something in his hand. Then he stepped forward and smiled.

"Excuse me," he said. "I think you dropped your keys."

questions.prompt: What had Elif read about?
questions.explanation: "She had read about a series of robberies in the area"

questions.prompt: What was the man holding?

learn.explanation:
B1'de üç temel anlatı zamanını öğrendiniz. B2'de bunları **bilinçli seçimlerle** kullanarak etki yaratırız.

| Zaman | Hikâyedeki işlevi | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Past continuous** | Sahneyi kurar, yavaşlatır, gerilim yaratır | She **was walking** towards the car park ... |
| **Past simple** | Olayları ilerletir, hızlandırır | She **stopped**. The footsteps **stopped** too. |
| **Past perfect** | Geri dönüş (flashback), arka plan bilgisi | She **had read** about a series of robberies. |

**Ritim için ipuçları:**

- **Kısa past simple cümleleri** gerilim yaratır: *She stopped. The footsteps stopped too.*
- **Uzun past continuous cümleleri** atmosfer kurar: *The rain was falling softly and the town was sleeping.*
- Past perfect'i **paragrafın başında bir kez** kullandıktan sonra past simple'a dönebilirsiniz; okuyucu zaten geri dönüşte olduğunu anlar.

**Sık hata:** Her geçmiş olayı past perfect ile anlatmak. Past perfect sadece **zaman çizgisinde geri gittiğinizde** gereklidir.

examples.en: The sun was setting and the children were playing on the beach.
examples.tr: Güneş batıyordu ve çocuklar sahilde oynuyordu.

examples.en: He opened the door. Nobody was there.
She had never seen anything so beautiful.
examples.tr: Hiç bu kadar güzel bir şey görmemişti.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede hikâye anlatırken zamanlar arasında "-yordu", "-dı" ve "-mıştı" ile geçiş yaparız ve bu İngilizceye oldukça iyi uyar. B2 seviyesinde asıl hedef doğruluktan çok etkidir: Türkçe konuşanlar genellikle tek bir zamana (çoğunlukla past simple) bağlı kalır ve anlatım düz kalır. Zamanları değiştirerek hikâyenin hızını kontrol edin.

She was slowly opening the door while she was thinking.

task.prompt: "Sisli gece" hikâyesine benzer, gerilimli bir sahne anlatın (gece eve dönerken, boş bir binada, bir yolculukta). Past continuous ile atmosferi kurun, kısa past simple cümleleriyle gerilimi artırın, bir past perfect ile geri dönüş yapın ve beklenmedik bir sonla bitirin.
task.modelAnswer: It was late and the last bus had already left. I was walking home through the park. The trees were moving in the wind and there wasn't a single person around. Suddenly, I heard a noise. I stopped. Something was moving behind the bushes. I had seen a film about a wolf in a city park only the week before, and I was terrified. Then a small white dog ran out and started licking my shoes!

learn.explanation:
**Past perfect continuous:** had been + fiil-**ing**

Geçmişteki bir andan **önce başlamış ve o ana kadar süren** eylemleri anlatır. **Süre** ve **süreç** vurgulanır.

| Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|
| Geçmişteki bir ana kadar süren eylem (+ süre) | By the time the plane took off, we **had been sitting** there **for six hours**. |
| Geçmişte görünen bir sonucun nedeni | Her eyes were red. She **had been crying**. |
| Geçmişte yarım kalan bir plan | I **had been planning** to see the play, but ... |

**Zaman çizgisi:**

```
  [had been sitting.................]X took off   →  şimdi
   (6 saat boyunca)                  (geçmişteki an)
```

**Present perfect continuous ile karşılaştırın:**

- I'm tired. I**'ve been working** all day. (Şimdiye kadar)
- I was tired. I **had been working** all day. (Geçmişteki bir ana kadar)

**Durum fiilleri** (know, be, have, like) continuous olmaz: She **had known** him for years. (~~had been knowing~~)

examples.en: The ground was wet. It had been raining all night.
examples.tr: Yer ıslaktı. Bütün gece yağmur yağmıştı.

examples.tr: Şirket kapandığında on yıldır orada çalışıyordu.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "on yıldır orada çalışıyordu" (şirket kapandığında) yapısı İngilizcede past perfect continuous'a denk gelir. Türkçe konuşanlar bu durumda genellikle "she was working there for ten years" der; ama geçmişteki bir ana kadar süren bir süreden bahsederken had been + -ing gerekir.

lessons.title: Simple mı, continuous mu?
lessons.goal: Past perfect simple ile past perfect continuous arasındaki anlam farkını kavrayıp doğru seçimi yapabilirim.

discover.title: Bir maratoncunun günlüğü
discover.body:
When I crossed the finish line, I burst into tears.

I had been training for this marathon for eighteen months. I had been getting up at five every morning, and I had been running in rain, snow and burning summer heat.

By race day, I had run more than 3,000 kilometres in training. I had worn out four pairs of running shoes, and I had lost nine kilos.

Three years earlier, I had never run more than five kilometres in my life. My doctor had told me to do more exercise, and I had chosen running almost by accident.

Now, at the age of 52, I had finished my first marathon.

questions.prompt: How long had the writer been training?
questions.explanation: "I had been training for this marathon for eighteen months"

questions.prompt: Why did the writer start running?
options: Their doctor told them to exercise more.
They wanted to win a race.
questions.explanation: "My doctor had told me to do more exercise"

learn.explanation:
| Past perfect **simple** | Past perfect **continuous** |
|---|---|
| **Sonuç, tamamlanmış iş, sayı** | **Süreç, süre, tekrarlanan eylem** |
| I **had run** 3,000 km. | I **had been running** for 18 months. |
| I **had worn out** four pairs of shoes. | I **had been getting up** at five every morning. |
| **How many / How much?** | **How long?** |

**Aynı fiil, farklı vurgu:**

- She **had painted** the kitchen. (Bitmişti; sonuç)
- She **had been painting** the kitchen. (Süreç; üstü boyalıydı, belki bitmemişti)

**Sayı ya da miktar varsa → simple:**

- He **had written** three novels by the age of 30. (~~had been writing three novels~~)

**Tek seferlik, kısa eylemler → simple:**

- She **had broken** her leg. (~~had been breaking~~)

Bu, present perfect simple / continuous farkının (B1) geçmişteki karşılığıdır.

examples.en: She had been crying, but she had stopped by the time I arrived.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "-mıştı" ve "-yordu" ayrımı bu farkı kabaca karşılar: "3.000 km koşmuştum" (simple, sonuç) ve "18 aydır koşuyordum" (continuous, süre). Cümlede bir sayı ya da "kaç tane" sorusu varsa simple, "ne zamandır" vurgusu varsa continuous seçin.

lessons.title: Güçlü kelimelerle anlat
lessons.goal: Güçlü sıfatlar, derecelendirme zarfları ve anlatı bağlayıcılarıyla hikâyemi daha canlı hale getirebilirim.

lines.speaker: Selim
lines.text: So how was the camping trip?

lines.speaker: Damla
lines.text: Absolutely unforgettable. On the first night it was freezing, and we were utterly exhausted after the climb.

lines.speaker: Damla
lines.text: It gets better. All of a sudden, we heard something huge moving outside the tent. We were terrified!

learn.explanation:
**Normal sıfatlar ve güçlü (aşırı) sıfatlar:**

| Normal | Güçlü |
|---|---|
| tired | **exhausted** |
| scared | **terrified** |
| angry | **furious** |
| cold | **freezing** |
| funny | **hilarious** |
| surprised | **astonished** |
| sad | **devastated** |
| good | **fantastic, superb** |

**Zarf eşleşmeleri** çok önemlidir:

| Normal sıfatlarla | Güçlü sıfatlarla |
|---|---|
| **very, extremely, a bit** | **absolutely, utterly, completely** |
| very tired ✓ | absolutely exhausted ✓ |
| ~~absolutely tired~~ ✗ | ~~very exhausted~~ ✗ |

**really** ikisiyle de kullanılabilir: really tired ✓ / really exhausted ✓

**Anlatı bağlayıcıları:**

- **All of a sudden / Suddenly** → ani olay
- **Meanwhile** → aynı anda başka yerde
- **Eventually / In the end** → uzun süre sonra
- **It turned out that ...** → sonradan anlaşıldı ki
- **To my surprise / horror / relief** → duygu

examples.en: I was absolutely furious when I saw the bill.
Meanwhile, back at home, my parents were getting worried.
examples.tr: Bu arada evde annemle babam endişelenmeye başlamıştı.

examples.en: To my relief, the doctor said it was nothing serious.
examples.tr: Doktorun ciddi bir şey olmadığını söylemesi beni rahatlattı.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "çok" kelimesini her sıfatla kullanabiliriz (çok yorgun, çok bitkin). İngilizcede ise very güçlü sıfatlarla kullanılmaz: "very exhausted" ya da "very hilarious" doğal değildir. Güçlü sıfatlarla absolutely, utterly, completely ya da really kullanın. "eventually" kelimesi Türkçedeki "eventüel" (muhtemel) anlamına gelmez; "sonunda" demektir.

practice.text: It was ___ cold, so we stayed inside. (çok; normal sıfatla)
The view was ___ amazing. (kesinlikle; güçlü sıfatla)
It turned ___ that the man was a famous actor.
To my ___, nobody was hurt. (rahatlama)

practice.audioText: We'd been driving for hours and we were completely lost. Meanwhile, the petrol light was flashing. Eventually, we found a tiny village, and to our surprise, the only petrol station was open.
options: Küçük bir köy ve açık bir benzin istasyonu

task.prompt: Aşağıdaki "düz" hikâyeyi JAI'ye daha canlı şekilde yeniden anlatın: "I went to a concert. It was good. I was tired. It was cold outside. I lost my phone. I found it later." Güçlü sıfatlar, doğru zarflar ve en az 4 anlatı bağlayıcısı ekleyin.
task.modelAnswer: Last Saturday I went to an absolutely fantastic concert. The band was superb. By the end, I was utterly exhausted from dancing. When we left, it was freezing outside. All of a sudden, I realised my phone had gone. I was devastated! Meanwhile, my friends were looking everywhere. Eventually, it turned out that a security guard had found it under a seat. To my relief, it wasn't even broken.

learn.explanation:
**İyi bir anlatının yapısı:**

| Bölüm | Amaç | Kalıplar |
|---|---|---|
| **Giriş** | Dikkati çek | **Did I ever tell you about the time** ...? / **You'll never guess what happened** ... / **I'll never forget** ... |
| **Arka plan** | Sahneyi kur | **It was** a hot summer day ... / I'd been ... for ages |
| **Gelişme** | Gerilimi artır | **Then, all of a sudden**, ... / **Hang on, it gets worse.** |
| **Doruk** | Ana olay | **The moment** I ..., ... / **No sooner had** I ... **than** ... (resmî) |
| **Son** | Toparla | **In the end**, ... / **Long story short**, ... / **Looking back**, ... |

**Dinleyici olarak tepki vermek:**

- Merak: **What happened next? / And then? / Go on!**
- Şaşkınlık: **You're joking! / No way! / I can't believe it!**
- Empati: **Oh no! / That must have been awful.** (must have → Ünite 7)
- Mizah: **That's hilarious!**

**the moment / as soon as** + past simple → "-ır -maz":

- **The moment** I opened the door, the alarm **went off**.

examples.en: Did I ever tell you about the time I met a famous footballer?
examples.tr: Ünlü bir futbolcuyla tanıştığım zamanı sana anlattım mı hiç?

examples.en: The moment she walked in, everyone stopped talking.
examples.tr: İçeri girdiği anda herkes konuşmayı kesti.

examples.en: Long story short, we missed the flight.

learn.turkishNote: "Uzun lafın kısası" ifadesinin İngilizce karşılığı "Long story short" ya da "To cut a long story short"tur. Türkçede de olduğu gibi, iyi bir hikâyeci sonucu en başta söylemez; "Hang on, it gets worse" gibi ifadelerle dinleyiciyi bekletir.

options: Did I ever tell you about the time ...?

task.prompt: Bir hikâye yarışması için "Hayatımın en tuhaf günü" başlıklı kısa bir öykü yazın (180–220 kelime). Gerçek ya da hayali olabilir. Bütün anlatı zamanlarını (past perfect continuous dahil), en az 4 güçlü sıfat (doğru zarflarla), anlatı bağlayıcıları ve beklenmedik bir son kullanın.
task.modelAnswer:
The Strangest Day of My Life

It was a grey Monday morning in November, and I was running late for the most important interview of my career. I had been preparing for weeks, and I had practised my answers so many times that I could say them in my sleep.

I was rushing down the stairs of the metro when, all of a sudden, an elderly man in front of me slipped and fell. Everyone else hurried past. I stopped, helped him up and carried his bag to a bench. He had been visiting his granddaughter, he told me, and he was utterly exhausted.

By the time I reached the office, I was twenty minutes late and absolutely furious with myself. The receptionist looked at me coldly and told me to wait.

Eventually, the door opened and the director came out. I couldn't believe my eyes. It was the man from the metro! He smiled and said, "I've been looking for someone who stops when others don't."

Long story short, I got the job. Looking back, being late was the best mistake I've ever made.

questions.prompt: Bir yolculukta başınıza gelen (gerçek ya da hayali) beklenmedik bir olayı anlatın (180–220 kelime). Past simple, past continuous, past perfect ve past perfect continuous'u bilinçli kullanın; güçlü sıfatlar, anlatı bağlayıcıları ve dinleyicinin ilgisini çeken bir giriş ve son ekleyin.
questions.modelAnswer:
I'll never forget my first trip to Cappadocia. My friends and I had been planning it for months, and we had booked a hot-air balloon flight for sunrise on our second day.

That morning, we got up at four. It was absolutely freezing, and we were all half asleep. We had been waiting at the take-off field for almost an hour when the pilot announced that the flight was cancelled because of the wind. We were devastated.

We were walking back to the minibus when, all of a sudden, an old man waved at us from a small farmhouse. He had been watching us, he explained, and he wanted to invite us for breakfast. To our surprise, his wife had already prepared a huge table with fresh bread, cheese, eggs and homemade jam.

Meanwhile, the sun was rising over the valleys, and dozens of balloons from other companies were flying in the distance. It turned out that only our company had cancelled!

Looking back, I'm actually glad. I've seen balloons in a hundred photos, but that breakfast with strangers was something truly unique.
